#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_ROOT="${PROJECT_ROOT:-/work/abussing/arka_trying_gpu_again/bsfm_19section_production_20261024}"
PYTHON="${PYTHON:-/work/abussing/arka_trying_gpu_again/env/bin/python3}"
TASK_ID="${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID:?Run as a 0-based Slurm array task}"
CHAINS=4
SECTION_INDEX="$((TASK_ID / CHAINS))"
CHAIN_INDEX="$((TASK_ID % CHAINS + 1))"

module load cuda/12.3 gcc/12.2.0
export JAX_ENABLE_X64=True
export JAX_PLATFORMS=cuda
export XLA_FLAGS="--xla_gpu_cuda_data_dir=/work/apps/cuda/12.3"
export XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false
THREADS="${SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK:-4}"
export OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="$THREADS"
export OMP_NUM_THREADS="$THREADS"
export MKL_NUM_THREADS="$THREADS"

cd "$PROJECT_ROOT"
SECTION="$($PYTHON -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(open("inputs/INPUT_PREPARATION_CONTRACT.json")); print(d["section_order"][int(sys.argv[1])])' "$SECTION_INDEX")"
SECTION_DIR="inputs/sections/$SECTION"
OUTPUT="production_runs/$SECTION/chain_$CHAIN_INDEX"
ADAPTATION="adaptation_runs/$SECTION/chain_$CHAIN_INDEX"
SEED="$((2026102400 + SECTION_INDEX * 100 + CHAIN_INDEX))"

$PYTHON -c 'import json,sys; from pathlib import Path; s=Path(sys.argv[1]); assert json.load(open(s/"mesh"/"MESH_CERTIFICATE.json"))["status"]=="PASS"; assert json.load(open(s/"gpinit"/"GPINIT_CERTIFICATE.json"))["status"]=="PASS"' "$SECTION_DIR"
test -s "$ADAPTATION/LATEST_CHECKPOINT.npz"
if [[ -e "$OUTPUT/C3FULL_SAMPLER_CERTIFICATE.json" || -e "$OUTPUT/LATEST_CHECKPOINT.npz" ]]; then
  echo "REFUSING_NONEMPTY_RUN output=$OUTPUT" >&2
  exit 3
fi
mkdir -p "$OUTPUT"
cp code/PRODUCTION_CODE_MANIFEST.json "$OUTPUT/code_manifest.json"
cp code/PRODUCTION_RETENTION_CONTRACT.json "$OUTPUT/retention_contract.json"
$PYTHON code/production/write_run_manifest.py \
  --output "$OUTPUT/input_manifest.json" --section-dir "$SECTION_DIR" \
  --rule rules/L16_ell14.npz --code-manifest code/PRODUCTION_CODE_MANIFEST.json \
  --panel-contract panel/GENE_PANEL_CONTRACT.json \
  --retention-contract code/PRODUCTION_RETENTION_CONTRACT.json \
  --checkpoint "$ADAPTATION/LATEST_CHECKPOINT.npz" \
  --chain "$CHAIN_INDEX" --stage readaptation_and_production --seed "$SEED"

echo "CHAIN_START section=$SECTION chain=$CHAIN_INDEX seed=$SEED host=$(hostname) time=$(date --iso-8601=seconds)"
$PYTHON -u code/sampler/run_c3full_fixed_profile_nuts.py \
  --root code \
  --data "$SECTION_DIR/OBSERVATIONS.npz" --real-data \
  --gpinit "$SECTION_DIR/gpinit/gpinit.npz" \
  --mesh "$SECTION_DIR/mesh" \
  --rule rules/L16_ell14.npz \
  --out "$OUTPUT" \
  --resume-checkpoint "$ADAPTATION/LATEST_CHECKPOINT.npz" \
  --readapt-on-resume \
  --warmup 100 --sweeps 1100 --settling-sweeps 100 --save-every 5 \
  --score-n 256 --score-every 5 \
  --live-warp-hypers --direct-w --split-E --target-accept 0.95 \
  --ell-eta-initial 0.14 --ell-eta-prior-center 0.14 \
  --pcg-tolerance 1e-10 --pcg-max-iterations 80 \
  --warmup-fidelity-checks 10 --fidelity-every 5 --fidelity-pairs 1024 \
  --fidelity-warn-only --max-num-doublings 10 --record-scale-feedback \
  --seed "$SEED" \
  --ell-u-prior-center 1.0 \
  --sigma-u-prior-center 0.31622776601683794 \
  --log-r-prior-sd 0.3

$PYTHON -c 'import json,sys; p=sys.argv[1]; d=json.load(open(p)); assert d["status"] in ("PASS","REVIEW_REQUIRED"); print("CHAIN_CERTIFICATE",d["status"])' "$OUTPUT/C3FULL_SAMPLER_CERTIFICATE.json"
echo "CHAIN_END section=$SECTION chain=$CHAIN_INDEX time=$(date --iso-8601=seconds)"
